label: Slider
purpose: Generic carousel wrapper that displays a sequence of nested 'slide' blocks
_notes: This block has no content settings of its own — all real settings (transition type, autoplay, arrows/dots color and position, slides-per-page, spacing, border radius, adaptive height, desktop/mobile variants, margins) are pure visual/behavioral carousel styling. Its actual content lives entirely in nested blocks of type 'slide' (see slide.json — image, heading, subheading, text, button). Nested block-in-block containment isn't represented by this catalog's schema format, so this schema only covers the slider wrapper's own (empty) settings, not what can be nested inside it.
